gist: Manchester City suffered a third straight Premier League loss after being beaten 3-1 by Forest.
Manager Enzo Maresca faces defensive issues and questions over the team's low intensity and errors.
City sit six points behind the champions heading into the international break.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Manchester City fell to a 3-1 defeat against Forest at the City Ground, marking their third consecutive Premier League loss. Defensive blunders allowed Jair Cunha and Liam Delap to score. A strike from Rayan Cherki gave City brief hope, but they could not turn the match around.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The defeat leaves City six points behind the champions after 10 games, a position from which few teams have recovered to win the title. Manager Enzo Maresca faces growing pressure regarding defensive vulnerabilities, individual errors, and squad trust during the international break.

gist: Manchester United drew four-all with Aston Villa after scoring a stoppage-time equaliser.
Manager Michael Carrick remains in his position despite United dropping into the relegation zone.
Fans protested against club owners and ticket prices amid poor league form.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Manchester United drew four-all against Aston Villa in an eight-goal thriller at Old Trafford. United fought back twice from two goals down, securing a point with a ninety-sixth-minute equaliser from Patrick Dorgu. The result left United in eighteenth place in the relegation zone during the international break.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: United are in their lowest league position for forty years after playing at least ten matches, having failed to win a league game since August. The poor form has intensified pressure on manager Michael Carrick and sparked unprecedented fan protests against ticket prices and club ownership.
